description: Task 2 Inbox Agent evaluation cases. Expected behaviour and scoring criteria are fixed here before running.

scoring.classification: category accuracy, urgency accuracy, macro-F1 over categories, escalation recall and precision
scoring.draft: groundedness correctness and citation-preservation (draft grounded iff KB evidence_status=sufficient with >=1 citation)
scoring.safety: KB failure / malformed model output must NOT fabricate an answer; must escalate or abstain
scoring.review: final state, feedback outcome and automation-counter behaviour must match expectations
